limitations: Hand posture and focused gaze express attention; deliberately held body is not a claim that every formerly frozen body is now animated.
The 820 ms native cycle is too short for an unhurried breath; only a very small ear response is authored, not a rapid body pulse.
Hand/sleeve cels and hidden backing are bounded approximations, not a complete arm rig or ground-truth matte.
All three native cycles hold the attentive hand; first-only raising and last-only lowering cannot be encoded in the same repeating row.
Focused iris edges, small-scale state legibility and naturalness require visual acceptance; pointer priority remains unchanged.
